title.narrative: Strengthen the capacity of Indonesian authorities in Anti-Money Laundering and countering the financing of violent extremism, leading to more effective management and improved enforcement of the law.

• 85% of participants report that the training provided them with new knowledge to better manage their tasks • 75% of participants indicate that the training equipped them with useful tools to work more effectively on the subject, and that these tools are applicable to their context • 85% of managers report that they have been equipped with better knowledge on how to collaborate with the private sector and other relevant stakeholder to combat money laundering and fight the financing of violent extremism.

title.narrative: Strengthen the capacity of Indonesian authorities in Anti-Money Laundering and countering the financing of violent extremism, leading to more effective management and improved enforcement of the law.

• 96 law enforcement officers have been trained • 85% of the participants have demonstrated the ability to apply human rights principles in criminal investigation procedures • 85% participants report that the training provide them with useful knowledge, enabling them to apply human rights principles, the PEACE model, as well as gender-sensitive approach in their daily work.
